name: DevHunt
conditions: Free launch is real but queued — the site states an average wait of about six months for a free launch.
GitHub account is the only login — it is also the credential voters use.
requirements: Developer tools only — DevHunt removes anything not for developers (marketing tools, consumer apps, general SaaS get taken down).
GitHub authentication required to submit; voters also need GitHub logins.
Weekly launch cycles with developer voting; launch day gives 24h homepage spotlight, morning email to subscribers, and a dofollow link.
preparation: At least 3 screenshots — the first becomes the social preview, so make it the product, not a hero banner.
Tool name, one-line slogan, website URL, optional GitHub repo URL.
A developer-focused description (API quality, docs, performance, integrations, language/framework support).
Decision: wait the ~6-month free queue or pay $49 to pick a launch week immediately.
workflow: Sign in at devhunt.org with GitHub.
Fill name, slogan, website URL, optional repo URL, logo, and ≥3 screenshots.
Pick a launch week in the free queue, or pay $49 to choose a week now (includes a launch video and top spot in the launch X thread).
During your launch week, rally developers (GitHub/Discord/dev communities) to vote — votes need GitHub login.
Weekly winners get a newsletter feature, social post, winner badge, and partner perks.
watchFor: Non-dev tools get removed — submitting a general SaaS wastes the queue slot.
Six-month average free queue is unusually long; the $49 'skip the queue' is the real product.
The new-tool page renders nothing without a GitHub session — you cannot even see the form logged out.
Additional paid options reported: newsletter ad $397, homepage ad $497.
countsAsLive: The tool appears in DevHunt's launch cycle for its scheduled week with a public tool page; during launch day it gets the homepage spotlight.
unknowns: Exact form field list behind GitHub auth.
Whether free-queue timing is contractually bounded or just an average.
Current paid price at checkout vs the reported $49.
